<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Unlike OSRS which has the RuneLite client, RS3 only has its NXT client. In order to add some extra QoL/features, the Alt1 Toolkit was developed by @skillbert. This channel serves as a brief overview about Alt1 and what it's used for, as well as some extra helpful add-ons/plugins developed for it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Alt1 Download</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>You can download Alt1 from the official </nowiki>[https://runeapps.org/alt1 <nowiki>RuneApps website</nowiki>]<nowiki>.
For Alt1 support/queries, please visit the </nowiki>[https://discord.gg/G3SbcS8 <nowiki>RuneApps discord</nowiki>]<nowiki>.
You can also check out the </nowiki>[https://runeapps.org/forums/ <nowiki>RuneApps forums</nowiki>]<nowiki>.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>If you have any issues with regard to Alt1, </nowiki><em><nowiki>please</nowiki></em><nowiki> use the dedicated RuneApps discord server that has a section for player support.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="alt1-overview"><ins><nowiki>Alt1 Overview</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="what-is-alt1"><nowiki>What Is Alt1</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Alt1 is a 3rd-party program that consists of several application overlays on your screen. They get information by reading your screen, and provide a bunch of QoL/useful features.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>A detailed explanation of Alt1's features can be found on the Alt1 website, but amongst its default features it includes:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>AFK Warden</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - the most common use for Alt1, its in-game activity detection overlays</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Clue Solver</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - solves all clue puzzles and displays output as an overlay to speed up clue solving</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>DgKey</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - an overlay of your Dungeoneering </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1" alt="dungeoneering" title="dungeoneering" kind="icon" /><nowiki> map to keep track of gatestones, teammates, etc.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Stats Lookup</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - look up a player's stats ;stats;, quest points, etc.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Item Lookup</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - quickly find any item's page on the Runescape Wiki</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>D&amp;D Notifications</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - opt-in for D&amp;D notification alerts</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>XpMeter</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - track XP/hr rates in real time</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Droplogger</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - an alternative to using the endgame RuneMetrics drop log</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="how-it-works"><nowiki>How It Works</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Alt1 is designed to capture images of the NXT Client and parse them with an OCR (Optical Character Recognition) Library.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The captured data is then transformed into pixel data that can be used in Alt1 apps.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ More information can be found on the forums and in the Alt1 Toolkit discord.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="is-it-safe"><nowiki>Is It Safe?</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Alt1 is essentially a glorified Chromium browser that creates overlays over your game. Every Alt1 app is essentially a webpage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Alt1 does not send any inputs or otherwise directly interact with your client beyond reading the pixels on the screen.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>It is not a client, therefore you won't get banned for using it.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="afk-warden"><ins><nowiki>AFK Warden</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/UG5psi4.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="what-is-afk-warden"><nowiki>What Is AFK Warden</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This is one of the most commonly used Alt1 apps, so will be covered in some detail here.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This reads the pixels on your screen to recognize your character, buff bars, chatbox and more in order to provide AFK alert notifications.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ It tracks a number of things, including:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• HP </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="Constitution" title="Constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Prayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> alerts</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Buff timers like </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1" alt="LantaSticks" title="LantaSticks" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Familiar duration </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1" alt="Summoning" title="Summoning" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Loot beams </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AFK lobby timers</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Seren Spirits and Blessings of the Gods</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Character stance (for AFK skilling alerts)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• XP drops, and more.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="clue-solver"><ins><nowiki>Clue Solver</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/EhTPOsI.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="what-is-clue-solver"><nowiki>What Is Clue Solver</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This is a very useful app that looks at your currently open clue on screen, and tells you how to solve it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ It handles all clue steps, including puzzle boxes, scans, compass clues, etc. With the exception of scan clues.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Have your clue visible on-screen clearly and click the 'Unlock Any' button to find a solution to your clue that will be displayed on the overlay.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="useful-3rd-party-alt1-apps"><ins><nowiki>Useful 3rd-Party Alt1 Apps</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>In addition to the default apps that come with Alt1, there are a number of other useful third-party apps that can be installed, which will briefly be covered here.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="how-to-install-alt1-apps"><nowiki>How to Install Alt1 Apps</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Alt1 Addons can be installed by going to the correct URL in either your normal browser or the Alt1 in-built browser</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This will bring up a prompt to add the application to Alt1.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The list of apps below have the full URL following each one.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note that none of these links will work on mobile, as they require Alt1 to be installed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Catalyst Tracker</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - tracks clues from Catalyst of alterations displayed in the chat window</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pre>alt1://addapp/https://ibbykay.github.io/CatalystClueTracker/appconfig.json
</pre>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Clue Splits</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - automatically tracks your clue times while doing a clue run, with no input required </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pre>alt1://addapp/https://yongyi781.github.io/clue-split/appconfig.json
</pre>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
